_instructions: Edit this file to change the visual appearance of the website. Save and refresh your browser to see changes.

colors._note: Use hex (#rrggbb) or rgba(r, g, b, alpha) format. alpha is 0.0 (transparent) to 1.0 (solid).

typography._note: fontFamily: list fonts in order of preference. The site uses Inter by default. To use CoFo Sans, add the font files to assets/fonts/, uncomment @font-face in styles.css, and put 'CoFo Sans' first here.

sections._note: Width of each horizontal section in vw units (1vw = 1% of screen width). experience/projects/leadership are auto-measured from content.json at load time (js/main.js fitAllSectionWidths) and will resize themselves as you add or remove entries — the values below are just the initial fallback shown for a split second before that runs. hero/nav/hobbies/contact are not auto-sized and can be tuned here.

spacing._note: sectionPadding: horizontal breathing room inside each section. portraitHeight: height of the portrait photo (e.g. '33vh' = 1/3 screen, '50vh' = half screen, '280px' = fixed pixels).

scroll._note: wheelMultiplier: scroll speed (1.0 = normal, 2.0 = fast). easing: glide smoothness — lower is slower/silkier (0.05), higher is snappier (0.15). snapDelay: milliseconds of stillness before snap fires. snapCommit: fraction of a segment you must cross before it advances you forward (0.0–0.5, default 0.15 = 15%).
